package rulefixtures

import "sort"

// scenario for go_perf_layer_hot_path_optimization_allocation_in_hash_or_less_func: Layer: Hot path optimization. Flag allocations inside sort comparison or hashing callbacks.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
type record544 struct {
	first  string
	second string
}

func scenario544Positive(items []record544) {
	// The Less function allocates a new string via fmt.Sprintf on
	// every comparison — O(n log n) allocations. A zero-allocation
	// approach would compare the fields directly without building
	// an intermediate string.
	sort.Slice(items, func(i, j int) bool {
		left := items[i].first + ":" + items[i].second
		right := items[j].first + ":" + items[j].second
		return left < right
	})
}
